title: #musicaltheatre #broadway #offbroadway #glee #spellingbeemusical
transcript: my favorite musical comedy of the 21st century is back with one of the best casts in New York right now and i finally got to see it this weekend. maybe it's my nostalgia goggles from having been in the show in high school (and let me know in the comments who you think i played) but even in my best attempt to be unbiased i still think The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee holds up extreme really well and i didn't see the original production but i do think this revival does justice to the material pretty beautifully from the scripted humor to the more improvised, variable humor and also the pathos like even aside from the more overt moments of deep emotion this musical displays such a tender love for its oddball, adolescent characters and you better believe i was just completely sobbing during The I Love You Song i think i appreciated that song and even really the show as a whole even more now that i'm older. i think the changes they made to the script were pretty small but effective and there are really no weak links in this cast but i i do think Jasmine Amy Rogers is the standout in her captivating performance as Olive, a role that could not be more different from Betty Boop but she nailed it just as much and i have to say even though i'm deeply familiar with the material this was my first time seeing it professionally and i really couldn't have asked for a better way to revisit the show after all these years and especially if you're not yet familiar with the show i really think this is a must see
